transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. It's nice to meet you too. 

Well, I came in today because... I've been having these nights of eating. And afterwards, I just sit there with crumbs and empty containers all around me, feeling so ashamed and... just disgusted with myself. It's terrible. I feel so bad about it that I can hardly even pray, or look folks at church in the eye the next morning. So, I figured it was time to get some help.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't. I've never made myself throw up. I just... well, I just sit there feeling overly full and miserable, but I don't ever try to make myself sick on purpose.
During these eating episodes, do you feel unable to control what or how much you are eating?

Yes, I do. That's exactly what it feels like. Once I take that first bite—usually after the house is quiet for the night—it's like my good sense just steps aside. Even while I'm sitting there telling myself, 'Belinda, stop now,' my hands just keep reaching for more. I just... I can't seem to stop it once it starts.
How often do these eating episodes happen?
Well, ever since my friend passed, these late-night eating spells have been happening at least once or twice most weeks. And... there just hasn't been a month where they really let up.
How long have these eating episodes been happening at least once or twice most weeks?
It's been going on for about five months now. It all really started right after my closest bridge partner and church friend died... that's when this whole thing began.
